rubrics.justification: Description is broadly consistent with a Day 5 expanded/hatching 4BB blastocyst, including fair ICM and TE and thinned zona, though some comments (e.g., partial collapse, granularity) are somewhat speculative from a single image.
Thoroughly integrates age-related aneuploidy risk, ovarian reserve, tubal factor, endometrial thickness, semen parameters, lifestyle, and first-cycle status with embryo quality and prognosis.

Reasoning is logical and internally consistent, with prognosis appropriately centered on maternal age and embryo competence; minor uncertainty arises from discussing fresh vs frozen transfer without knowing which applies.

Recommendations are largely evidence-based and aligned with standard IVF practice, including SET, hydrosalpinx attention, avoiding bed rest, and selective use of PGT-A/testing; slight overreach in mentioning some ancillary evaluations without clear indication.

Provides practical next steps for transfer and future planning, including progesterone support, hydrosalpinx review, and when to consider PGT-A or further workup, though some advice remains somewhat general rather than protocol-specific.
